messages:
Alex Morgan: Need to assign a PIR host for RWINF-504. Looking for someone to run ~60m, own notes, and drive postmortem actions. EMEA-friendly preferred but PST morning ok.

Sara Li: I can take it if it's no later than 16:00 UTC. Im able to pull the logs and PV numbers. :hand: 

Matt Gonzales: I can host Tue next week 09:00 PDT / 16:00 UTC. I'll create the notes doc and track action owners. @Priya Shah want to co-lead timeline review?

Priya Shah: Yep, Ill co-run timeline and own PD handoff timestamps. Ill bring the mitigation steps and the exact batch metrics we captured. :+1:

Alex Morgan: Sounds good. Matt host, Priya timeline. Please confirm attendee list and whether CS/product need to join. Also we need a single pre-read packet (incident TL;DR + raw timeline + log snapshot).

Jamie Ortega: Please loop in Carmen (CS lead) and Victor (AM)  they want a short customer readout.

incident-bot: Incident RWINF-504: PagerDuty triggered 2026-03-06T02:41Z. Impact: elevated token latencies for Hosted API in us-west-2 (affecting ~15% of requests). Root link: https://rwinf.incidents/pd/RWINF-504

Alex Morgan: Draft pre-read links:
- Incident TL;DR: https://docs.redwood/incident/RWINF-504
- Raw timeline + traces: https://docs.redwood/incident/RWINF-504/timeline
- Logs & KV-cache snapshot: https://s3.redwood/infra/rwinf-504/logs.zip
- Quick PV & batching query: https://grafana.redwood/d/rwinf-504

Alex Morgan: Host checklist to paste into notes:
```
- Open PIR notes doc and paste TL;DR
- Confirm attendees and roles (Host / Timeline / SRE / CS / Product)
- Walk timeline: pre-alert state -> alert -> mitigation -> recovery
- Capture actions with owner + due date + severity
- Add observability links (latency/cost/pv/batch sizes)
- Decide follow-ups: KV backfill, regression test, rollout gating
```

Matt Gonzales: Confirmed attendees: Matt (host), Priya (timeline), Sara (SRE), Jamie (CS), Carmen (CS lead - pending), Victor (AM), Nikhil (eng oncall), Elaine (ops observer). 7-8 people.

Sara Li: Ill paste the customer impact blurb into the pre-read tonight. Also will attach the exact batch-size table for 02:30-02:45 UTC.

Priya Shah: Proposal: Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 PDT / 16:00 UTC for 60m. If Carmen needs APAC, we can do a short 30m readout scheduled separately for APAC stakeholders.

Carmen Ruiz: I can join Tue 16:00 UTC. Ill prepare a 5-min customer-facing summary and churn/upsell risk estimate.

Alex Morgan: Locking Tue 2026-03-10 16:00 UTC. Matt to create invite and copy pre-read links in event. Ensure the notes doc has an action tracker table.

Matt Gonzales: Invite created (Zoom): https://zoom.us/j/2345678901
Calendar ICS, pasted in invite: 
```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
DTSTART:20260310T160000Z
DURATION:PT60M
SUMMARY:RWINF-504 Post-Incident Review
END:VCALENDAR
```
I added pre-read links + host checklist to the event description. :calendar:

Nikhil Rao: Quick ask  who owns the KV-cache backfill? I can take implementation but need a due date.

Matt Gonzales: Draft action rows in notes:
- KV-cache backfill (owner: Nikhil Rao, due 2026-03-17)
- Latency regression test (owner: Eng runtime, assignee tbd, due 2026-03-12)
- Rollback policy review (owner: Matt Gonzales, due 2026-03-11)

Priya Shah: Ill post the mitigation timeline with PD handoff timestamps in the notes tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: Reminder: PIR preread summary will be posted to #incidents 24h before meeting (includes action owners + pre-read links).

Jamie Ortega: Carmen/Victor  if you need us to escalate to AM leadership, flag it here by EOD Friday so we can prep the readout.

Victor Chen: Im on the invite. Will draft customer comms and share in the notes.

Matt Gonzales: Small favor  please double-check timezone conversions when accepting the invite. Host in PDT here.

Sara Li: Confirmed times in invite. Ive verified the UTC/PDT mapping.

Alex Morgan: Final: Matt host, Priya co-run (timeline), pre-read links posted, invite sent, initial actions added. If you cant make it, nominate a delegate here. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
